connect.lead: Your wallet address becomes your identity in ODP. The Creator ID is permanently linked to your wallet. Make sure you have a backup of your key before proceeding.
connect.btnDesc: Browser extension — MetaMask, Rabby, Brave Wallet, etc.

security.intro: Your Creator ID is tied to this wallet permanently. If you lose access to the wallet, the ID cannot be transferred or recovered. Read the following carefully.
security.li1t: Seed phrase wallets — back up before anything else
security.li1: Write the 12–24 words on paper. Verify word order when prompted. Store offline. Keep a second copy in a different location. Never store digitally — no photos, no cloud, no messaging apps.
security.li2t: Seed-less hardware wallets — get a backup device now
security.li2: The key lives only in the hardware chip. There is no seed phrase. Losing all copies of the device means permanent loss of access. Always have at least one backup device before registering.
security.li3t: Never share your key or seed phrase with anyone
security.li3: No legitimate service or support team will ever ask for it. Ransomware and phishing specifically target seed phrases.
security.li4t: If you lose wallet access — your passports are safe
security.li4: All passports you minted remain valid and verifiable forever. You only lose the ability to mint new passports under that identity.
security.checkbox: I have backed up my key and understand the risks. My seed phrase is on paper / I have a backup hardware device.

register.warn: ⚠ Your type prefix cannot be changed after registration. One Creator ID per wallet. Permanent.

type.Bd: Company, studio, label, collective (museums/collections use M)
type.Pd: Expert body, auction house, certification — attestations on passports
type.Md: Collection or museum: unlimited passports for holdings (e.g. works by deceased artists)

typeInfo.C: Individual creator — artist, photographer, maker, or craftsperson. Use this if you are registering as a person.
typeInfo.B: Brand or collective — company, studio, label, or group. Use this for organizations; museums/collections should use M.
typeInfo.P: Proof institution — expert, auction, or certification body. P-type accounts can attach attestations to any passport.
typeInfo.M: Museum or collection — mint passports for objects you hold in institutional custody (unlimited monthly mints). This is the required type for museums/collections digitizing holdings; can attach proofs like P.

errors.connectInProgress: Connection already in progress. Approve or reject the request in your wallet extension (icon in the toolbar), then try again.
errors.walletPending: A wallet request is already open. Use the wallet extension icon in your browser toolbar to approve or cancel — do not click Connect again until that finishes.

noWallet.line1: No injected wallet (window.ethereum). On desktop, install
noWallet.line2: or another extension, then reload this page.
noWallet.mmHint: iPhone / Safari: there is no extension — MetaMask runs as an app with a built-in browser. This link opens the same page there so Connect works.
noWallet.fileProto: Opening as file:// — many wallets do not inject on local files. Serve the web/ folder over http://localhost (any static server) or upload to HTTPS.
noWallet.httpsHint: Use https:// or http://localhost if the wallet still does not appear.

already.shareCaption: Open Share for a QR, the link, PNG download, or send via your device.
already.pl1: On your official website — prominently, not hidden in menus
already.pl2: In all your social media profiles and bios
already.pl3: On physical objects, packaging, and certificates you issue
already.pl4: In press releases and official communications

creator.qrFail: QR library did not load (network / CDN blocked).

docAttest.body: Upload the file (e.g. contract PDF). The page computes SHA-256 locally and sends only the hash in a transaction — gas only. Counterparties can hash their copy and check it matches this Creator ID on Verify. This is not a qualified e-signature; it records that this wallet anchored this hash at a time.
docAttest.uriLabel: Optional public URL to the same file (HTTPS)

pAff.body: For large organizations, you can link a child Proof Institution (school) to a parent Proof Institution (university) with a spam-resistant two-step handshake.
pAff.parentRequired: Enter a parent P Creator ID first.
pAff.childRequired: Enter a child P Creator ID first.
pAff.noPending: No pending request for this child under your parent affiliation.
